SUMMARY
FINAL ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT
Office of the Assistant Secretary for Research and Technology
Department of Housing and Urban Development Washington, D. C. 20410
Subject: Operation BREAKTHROUGH
1. Action: Administrative
2. <u>Brief Description of Action</u>: Operation BREAKTHROUGH is a major research and development activity of HUD to modernize the housing industry and bring about volume production of industrialized housing. One aspect of this program involves the demonstration of innovative housing systems on nine prototype sites in eightareas of the nation. This Environmental Statement sets forth the environmental impact aspects of this prototype demonstration activity.
3. Summary of Environmental Impact and Adverse Environmental Effects: The BREAKTHROUGH prototype demonstrations include cluster planning providing a mix of housing types and directed to a range of economic and racial elements in its occupants. Site planning has been conducted to provide improved living environments for all sites. Housing designs have been reviewed to insure quality design, safety, soundness and durability. Total energy and pneumatic trash collection systems are being tested and evaluated on one site.
Potential adverse environmental effects which have been considered include changes in storm runoff, visual effect of changing land use to housing from some other usage, impact on local community services by the addition of housing and population, and potential impact on local property values due to the new developments. Efforts have been undertaken to eliminate or control all these elements.
4. <u>List Alternatives Considered</u>: A) No program. B) Program directed only at housing technology. C) Different number and character of demonstration sites. D) Different site design philosophy in number and types of housing.
